summary: Verifier reviewed workflow-a CLI lifecycle, gate behavior, docs, and tests; criteria are covered by CLI implementation and lifecycle test.

criteria.criterion: CLI exposes Workflow A start, advance, snapshot, draft, admit, and authorize operations with durable session snapshots.

criteria.criterion: draft requires Human Gate 1 approval, admit runs RequestDraftAdmission, and authorize uses ApprovalService so agents cannot freeze a GoalExecutionRequest themselves.
